text_en: On the third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.
text_cn: 第三天，在加里肋亚加纳有婚宴，耶稣的母亲在那里；

text_en: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
text_cn: 耶稣和他的门徒也被请去赴婚宴。

text_en: When the wine gave out, the mother of Jesus said to him, “They have no wine. ”
text_cn: 酒缺了，耶稣的母亲向他说：“他们没有酒了。”

text_en: And Jesus said to her, “Woman, what concern is that to you and to me? My hour has not yet come. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“女人，这于我和你有什么关系？我的时刻尚未来到。”

text_en: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever he tells you. ”
text_cn: 他的母亲给仆役说：“他无论吩咐你们什么，你们就作什么。”

text_en: Now standing there were six stone water jars for the Jewish rites of purification, each holding twenty or thirty gallons.
text_cn: 在那里放着六口石缸，是为犹太人的取洁礼用的；每口可容纳两三桶水。

text_en: Jesus said to them, “Fill the jars with water. ” And they filled them up to the brim.
text_cn: 耶稣向仆役说：“你们把缸灌满水罢！”他们就灌满了，直到缸口。

text_en: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the chief steward. ” So they took it.
text_cn: 然后，耶稣给他们说：“现在你们舀出来，送给司席！”他们便送去了。

text_en: When the steward tasted the water that had become wine, and did not know where it came from (though the servants who had drawn the water knew), the steward called the bridegroom
text_cn: 司席一尝已变成酒的水──并不知是从哪里来的，舀水的仆役却知道──司席便叫了新郎来，

text_en: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and then the inferior wine after the guests have become drunk. But you have kept the good wine until now. ”
text_cn: 向他说：“人人都先摆上好酒，当客人都喝够了，才摆上次等的；你却把好酒保留到现在。”

text_en: Jesus did this, the first of his signs, in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
text_cn: 这是耶稣所行的第一个神迹，是在加里肋亚加纳行的；他显示了自己的光荣，他的门徒们就信从了他。

text_en: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they remained there a few days.
text_cn: 此后他和他的母亲、弟兄及门徒下到葛法翁，在那里住了不多几天。

text_en: The Passover of the Jews was near, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 犹太人的逾越节近了，耶稣便上了耶路撒冷。

text_en: In the temple he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and the money changers seated at their tables.
text_cn: 在殿院里，他发现了卖牛、羊、鸽子的，和坐在钱庄上兑换银钱的人，

text_en: Making a whip of cords, he drove all of them out of the temple, both the sheep and the cattle. He also poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
text_cn: 就用绳索做了一条鞭子，把众人连羊带牛，从殿院都赶出去，倾倒了换钱者的银钱，推翻了他们的桌子；

text_en: He told those who were selling the doves, “Take these things out of here! Stop making my Father’s house a marketplace! ”
text_cn: 给卖鸽子的人说：“把这些东西从这里拿出去，不要使我父的殿宇成为商场。”

text_en: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will consume me. ”
text_cn: 他的门徒就想起了经上记载的：“我对你殿宇所怀的热忱，把我耗尽”的话。

text_en: The Jews then said to him, “What sign can you show us for doing this? ”
text_cn: 犹太人便追问他说：“你给我们显什么神迹，证明你有权柄作这些事？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“你们拆毁这座圣殿，三天之内，我要把它重建起来。”

text_en: The Jews then said, “This temple has been under construction for forty-six years, and will you raise it up in three days? ”
text_cn: 犹太人就说：“这座圣殿建筑了四十六年，你在三天之内就会重建起它来吗？”

text_en: But he was speaking of the temple of his body.
text_cn: 但耶稣所提的圣所，是指他自己的身体。

text_en: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this; and they believed the scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
text_cn: 所以，当他从死者中复活以后，他的门徒就想起了他曾说过这话，便相信了《圣经》和耶稣说过的话。

text_en: When he was in Jerusalem during the Passover festival, many believed in his name because they saw the signs that he was doing.
text_cn: 当耶稣在耶路撒冷过逾越节庆节时，有许多人看见他所行的神迹，便信从了他；

text_en: But Jesus on his part would not entrust himself to them, because he knew all people
text_cn: 耶稣却不信任他们，因为他认识众人；

text_en: and needed no one to testify about anyone; for he himself knew what was in everyone.
text_cn: 他并不需要谁告诉他，人是怎样的，因为他认识在人心里有什么。
